title: The window in front takes the keys
why: His order (2026-10-18): if I bring the 2nd player screen to the front, it should take my key input, e.g. keys control whatever screen is to the top. The player 2 window handed every key to the player 1 window and did not act on it (v16.89). It now plays its own keys; the keyboard drives whichever window is in front. The player 2 mouse takes the crosshair back from its pad once the window is in front, and a key or click there drops player 2 into the arcade like A.
now: The keyboard now controls whichever game window is in front, so the player 2 window plays its own keys.

edits.replacement: if(typeof PAD!=='undefined'&&PAD&&(!(typeof NET!=='undefined'&&NET&&NET.same==='p2')||netPadFocused())) PAD.curOwn=0;   // v30.xx (cw-p2keys), HIS ORDER (2026-10-18): "keys control whatever screen is to the top". The player 2 window took the crosshair back from its pad never, so its mouse could not aim while a pad was on there (the pad placed the crosshair again every frame). In front, the mouse takes it back as in the player 1 window; a pointer only crossing a window that is not in front still leaves the pad crosshair alone
